package.name: velo2cam_gz_worlds
package.description: Gazebo models and worlds for benchmarking LiDAR-camera extrinsic calibration algorithms. Includes Velodyne LiDAR models (VLP-16, HDL-32, HDL-64), camera models (Blackfly S, Bumblebee XB3), and calibration target models with associated simulation worlds.
package.author: Jorge Beltran
